label: Child Tax Credit, tax year 2025
sourceCitation: Rev. Proc. 2025-32 section 2.03, recording the OBBBA amendment to IRC 24(h)(2)
notes: IRC 24(b)(2) sets the phase-out thresholds and they are not inflation adjusted. The credit falls by $50 for each $1,000 of modified adjusted gross income above the threshold.
